$comment: AUTHOR-WRITTEN, like motivation.json. The lead case study: one project told properly before the list starts. Nothing here may be generated, and nothing here may state a number — every figure on this surface comes from projects.json and publications.json through the same components the list entries use, so the case study cannot quietly claim more than the list does.
rule: Exactly one lead, and it must be a project that already carries BOTH a figure in content/figures.json and a peer-reviewed publication in publications.json. Without the figure there is nothing to show; without the paper it is an assertion at a larger size. _scripts/check-content.mjs enforces both.
paragraphs: A measured X-ray absorption band is almost never one thing. The number a chemist wants — where each transition sits, and how much of it there is — only exists once the band has been separated into components.

SpectraFit does that separation as a tool rather than as a script: a data file in, the fitted components and the residual out. It went through peer review, which is the part that matters — the method is described somewhere a reader can check it.
